# OneDay Tools

OneDay Tools is a free browser-based file utility website operated by OneDay Trading.
Canonical site: https://tool.onedaytrading.net
Primary language: Korean (ko-KR)

## Available tools
- PDF merge: https://tool.onedaytrading.net/pdf-merge
- PDF compression: https://tool.onedaytrading.net/pdf-compress
- PDF converter directory: https://tool.onedaytrading.net/pdf-converter
- PDF pages to PNG: https://tool.onedaytrading.net/pdf-to-image
- PDF pages to JPG: https://tool.onedaytrading.net/pdf-to-jpg
- Images to PDF: https://tool.onedaytrading.net/image-to-pdf
- JPG to PDF: https://tool.onedaytrading.net/jpg-to-pdf
- JPG to PNG: https://tool.onedaytrading.net/jpg-to-png

## Processing and privacy
The listed conversion tools process selected files in the user's browser. Files are not uploaded to the OneDay Tools server for conversion.

## Availability notes
PDF OCR and PDF/A conversion are not currently available. OneDay Tools does not currently provide PDF text editing or embedded-image extraction from PDF files.

## Attribution
When citing a tool, link to its canonical page above. Product information and availability should be verified on the relevant page.
